info.name: RentCheck REST Account Settings Residents V2 API

params.name: filters[search]
params.description: Search string to match against resident name, email, and phone number.

params.name: filters[deleted]
params.description: When `true`, returns soft-deleted residents. Defaults to `false`.

params.name: filters[active]
params.description: When provided, filters residents by whether they currently have an active occupancy.

params.name: filters[emails]
params.description: Email(s) to filter residents by. Multiple values may be comma-separated — the string is split on `,` and matched by array-overlap. Single-value requests remain a comma-free string.

params.name: filters[property_id]
params.description: Property ID to filter residents by. Only residents with an occupancy on this property are returned.

params.name: filters[occupancy_status][value]
params.description: Occupancy status(es) to filter residents by. Multiple values should be concatenated with a `|`. Allowed individual values are `future`, `past`, and `current`. When either `filters[occupancy_status][value]` or `filters[occupancy_status][condition]` is supplied, both are required.

params.name: filters[occupancy_status][condition]
params.description: Condition to be used to filter by occupancy status. The validator only accepts `any_of`. Must be paired with `filters[occupancy_status][value]` (see above). Note also that `filters[active]` and `filters[occupancy_status]` are mutually exclusive — supplying both is rejected by the request validator.

params.name: occupancy_status[]
params.description: Legacy multi-value occupancy status filter. Prefer `filters[occupancy_status][value]`.

params.name: options[pagination][page_size]
params.description: The number of elements in the data collection.

params.name: options[pagination][page_number]
params.description: The page number of the collection. This value is based on the page size.

params.name: options[sort][sort_by]
params.description: Sort results by one of the available fields.

items.docs: This resource allows you to list Residents in RentCheck. Supports both the new `filters[...]` / `options[...]` query schema and the legacy `occupancy_status[]` multi-value syntax.
This resource allows you to create a Resident in RentCheck. Residents are used to provide contact information for inspections.
This resource allows you to get a Resident in RentCheck. Residents are used to provide contact information for inspections.
This resource allows you to update a Resident in RentCheck. Residents are used to provide contact information for inspections.
